progression.narrative: The performance opens on Eb4 and dwells most on Gk in Phrase 1. Phrase 2 (0:13.1) introduces F, Ab, A, Bb, Cs, centred on Dk. Phrase 12 (3:12.7) introduces Ak, centred on F. Phrase 14 (3:34.6) introduces Gb, centred on Dk. The line peaks at Eb5 (641.6 Hz) at 4:58.1. It closes on the tonic (Gb4 → Ek4 → Gb4 → Gk4 → Gb4 → Dk4).
